en.title: ESP32 Recap: PWM, RGB LED, analogRead, map() and State Machines in 7 Questions | ESP32 From Zero
en.description:
A recap of episodes 5 to 10 in seven questions: how PWM makes a breathing LED, how the color LED mixes light, how analogRead() and map() turn a knob into a number, and how a state machine with goTo() remembers its steps. Grab a paper, pause after every question, and count your points at the end.

Lessons: https://github.com/emjnbulut/esp32-from-zero/tree/main/lessons
Learning Lab: https://emjnbulut.github.io/esp32-learning-lab/
Course source: https://github.com/emjnbulut/esp32-from-zero
